digest.component_or_area: Gerrit review bot four-pass pipeline / project criterion routing
propositions: Run an advisory-only live Gerrit dogfood probe to prove end-to-end project-criterion execution through the deployed review bot's webhook-to-checkout-to-prompt path.

Use one Gerrit change with three sequential patchsets: a positive control refining Pass-1 discovery that emits no boundary finding, a negative probe injecting a severity-assignment sentence, and a final cleaned patchset landed on main.

The negative-probe advisory finding must carry reviewer_id code-review-project-review-phase-boundaries and criteria [project.review-phase-boundaries] with Pass-3 decision advisory, threshold 0.90, and blocking_enabled false.
Keep blocking_enabled false and block_threshold 0.90 inert throughout; the probe is observational and does not change the rubric or promote the criterion.

If the pinned negative directive produces no criterion finding or the bot is absent/misconfigured, record the trace, file an operational or rubric/seam bug linked discovered_from, and mark the story blocked rather than substituting an offline run.

Post a calibration handoff comment with labels 'Priority distribution:' and 'Blocking promotion: deferred' naming a future separately-reviewed data-backed ticket as the only path to enabling blocking.
